name: [SHINY] Superpower Simulator: Chakra
desc:
👍15K likes for a new code!

💪 In Superpower Simulator: Chakra you can team up with Chakra and his friends to stop villains who want to take over the streets of Mumbai! Train your character, unlock new powers, and bring villains to justice or side with them in their quest for world domination! 🔥
Your journey will let you explore Mumbai and its many famous landmarks including The Gateway of India and the Bandra Worli Sea Link. 
⚡ Are you ready to become the strongest hero?
